basic_details.job_title: Kanya Mahavidyalaya Miraj Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 8 Posts
basic_details.department: Commerce, Economics, English, Geography, History, Music, Political Science, Sanskrit (one post each)
basic_details.application_mode: Application form from the official website (online/offline); printed copy with documents to the Secretary
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

important_dates.last_date_to_apply: Within 15 days of publication of the advertisement dated 23 November 2026 (about 08 December 2026)

qualification.details: For SC/ST candidates, a relaxation of 5% is given, from 55% to 50% of the marks at the Master's degree level. The notice does not mention experience. For the subject-wise eligibility of each post, candidates should check the official notification and the prescriptions of the Government of Maharashtra and Shivaji University, Kolhapur.

salary_details.pay_scale: As prescribed by the apex body, Govt. of Maharashtra and Shivaji University, Kolhapur from time to time

how_to_apply: Get the application form (online/offline) from the official website https://www.unishivaji.ac.in.
Submit a printed copy of the application, along with all documents, to The Secretary, The New Miraj Education Society, Miraj, Tal-Miraj, Dist-Sangli.
Submit it within 15 days from the date of publication of the advertisement. The advertisement is dated 23 November 2026, which gives about 08 December 2026 (15 days from 23 November 2026).
Reserved category candidates are advised to also send a copy of their application to the Deputy Registrar, Special Cell, Shivaji University, Kolhapur-416004 (Room No. 138).

Incomplete applications will not be entertained. The notice mentions an interview, where reserved category candidates other than SC/ST must produce the non-creamy layer certificate, but gives no interview date or venue.

The vacant posts and all terms and conditions are as mentioned in No Objection letter No. JDHE/Kolhapur/NOC/2026/00006 dated 17.09.2026 from the Deputy Secretary (Higher Education), Mantralaya, Mumbai.

content_sections.text: Incomplete applications will not be entertained. The notice mentions an interview, where reserved category candidates other than SC/ST must produce the non-creamy layer certificate, but gives no interview date or venue.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Printed copy of the application along with all documents. Caste Validity Certificate for reserved category candidates, as per State Government Circular No. BCC-2011/Pra. faq.question: Q1. How many Assistant Professor posts are there at Kanya Mahavidyalaya, Miraj?
faq.answer: There are 8 Assistant Professor posts, one each in Commerce, Economics, English, Geography, History, Music, Political Science and Sanskrit.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The notice asks for applications within 15 days from the date of publication of the advertisement, which is dated 23 November 2026. That gives about 08 December 2026 (15 days from 23 November 2026).

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Educational qualifications are as prescribed by the apex body, Govt. of Maharashtra and Shivaji University, Kolhapur from time to time. SC/ST candidates get a relaxation from 55% to 50% marks at the Master's degree level.

faq.question: Q4. What is the pay for the posts?
faq.answer: The notice says pay scales and service conditions are as prescribed by the apex body, Govt. of Maharashtra and Shivaji University, Kolhapur from time to time. It prints no pay amount.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Get the application form from https://kmm-recruitment.org and submit a printed copy with all documents to The Secretary, The New Miraj Education Society, Miraj, Tal-Miraj, Dist-Sangli, within 15 days of publication.

faq.question: Q6. Do reserved category candidates have to send a copy anywhere else?
faq.answer: Reserved category candidates are advised to send a copy of their application to the Deputy Registrar, Special Cell, Shivaji University, Kolhapur-416004 (Room No. 138).

faq.question: Q7. Which certificates must reserved category candidates produce?
faq.answer: Reserved category candidates must produce the Caste Validity Certificate. Those other than SC/ST must also produce a Non-Creamy layer certificate at the time of interview.

faq.question: Q8. How are reserved category candidates from outside Maharashtra treated?
faq.answer: Reserved category candidates from outside the State of Maharashtra will be treated as Open Category.

faq.question: Q9. How many posts are reserved for women?
faq.answer: The notice shows 1 post under Women 30%, in the OBC category. The posts for Sports Person, Person with disability and Orphans are shown as 00.
